name: InfiniteMenu-TS-TW
blurb: Drag to spin a 3D sphere of linked image cards.
description: Arranges image cards on a 3D icosphere controlled by pointer drag. Snaps to nearest item and displays linked title and description; rendered in WebGL2.
use_when: Showcasing a curated set of linked items (portfolio, product gallery, menu) with premium interactive polish.
avoid_when: On touch-only surfaces — requires precise pointer events. Needs WebGL2 support and sized parent container.
a11y: Canvas element; pointer-driven only, not keyboard accessible. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
